title: Making more than a just a product

content.text: creating a product that is useful and provides beautiful experience is one thing, and creating a product and making it a phenomenon is another thing.

but the thing is we can't embed phenomenon into only some product a company makes. the phenomenon happens not because of the product itself, but because of the company that makes it, the spirit of the company, the spirit of people who run that company ( but in almost all cases the kind of spirit that drives this kind of phenomenon is only present in the founders themselves. )

there's something that i find really great about few companies. they make something else beyond just a great product. making a product that solves a problem and provides a great experience is one thing, but making a product that becomes a phenomenon is another. there's something that the end user feels when using their product. the spirit. the products of that company make people feel different. there's something that gets carried along to the end user, and they feel great about it. it inspires the people.
whatever is the term for it, i want to call it a phenomenon. cause for me, it is. Nike and Apple are great examples of those, or used to be atleast. also Harley Davidson.
and i want to make that kind of product. which gives people something more beyond just usefulness, great aesthetics, and great user experience.
